content_sections.heading: Central University of Punjab Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 13 vacancies are available - 3 for Contractual Faculty (Pharmacy), 2 for Contractual Faculty (Law), 1 for Contractual Faculty (Economics), 1 for Part-Time Faculty (History), 1 for Part-Time Faculty (Political Science), 1 for Part-Time Faculty (Geography), 1 for Part-Time Faculty (Economics), 1 for Part-Time Faculty (Physics), 1 for Part-Time Faculty (Chemistry), 1 for Part-Time Faculty (Zoology), and 1 for Part-Time Faculty (Mathematics).

content_sections.heading: Central University of Punjab Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Essential: A basic degree in Pharmacy Registration as a Pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act, 1948, as amended from time to time, including any succeeding enactments First Class Master's Degree in an appropriate branch of specialization in Pharmacy Desirable: Teaching, research, industrial and/or professional experience in a reputed organization Papers presented at conferences and/or published in refereed journals As per UGC Regulations, 2018. (Specific degree/percentage requirements are not detailed in the notification beyond this reference.) Post-Graduate degree in the concerned subject with a minimum of 55% marks or its equivalent grade B.Ed. degree with a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent grade NET/SLET or Ph.D. in Education or in the concerned subject, as prescribed by the University Grants Commission for these categories of posts

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Central University of Punjab Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official recruitment portal: https://cuprec.samarth.edu.in Register and select the relevant post - for example, "Contractual Faculty" or "Part-Time Faculty" Select the concerned department (e.g., Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences & Natural Products, Department of Law, or Department of Education) as applicable to the post Fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and experience details Upload all relevant supporting documents (self-attested copies of degrees, certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, etc.) Pay the applicable application fee online (if not exempted) Submit the application before the last date specified for the respective post Download and print a copy of the submitted application form to carry for the interviewu

content_sections.heading: Central University of Punjab Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview No separate call letters will be issued; candidates who apply online by the last date must directly attend the interview on the notified date, time, and venue Eligibility of candidates will be decided at the time of the interview itself Candidates must make a 10-minute PPT presentation as part of the interview process

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Central University of Punjab Walk-in Interview 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must carry original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies of the following: Printed copy of the online application form Original certificates of educational/professional qualifications, Ph.D., NET, publications (degree/certificate + mark sheets), and original experience certificates indicating designation and period of service, with self-attested photocopies Copies of testimonials/recommendation letters from previous/present employer(s), if any All publications Original caste certificate, in case of Reserved Categories Certificate of the last pay drawn No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer - mandatory if the candidate has not applied through the proper channel or has changed employer Two passport-size photographs Aadhaar Card Any other documents required to establish eligibility for the post applied for

content_sections.text: Candidates possessing Postgraduate, B.Ed., NET/ SLET, Ph.D., B.Pharm., M.Pharm., Law, or other relevant qualifications can also explore more Teaching Jobs , Faculty Recruitment, and University Jobs available across India. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Central University of Punjab Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply differs by post: 08.08.2026 for Contractual Faculty (Pharmacy, Law, Economics); 09.08.2026 for Part-Time Faculty in History, Political Science, Geography, and Economics; and 10.08.2026 for Part-Time Faculty in Physics, Chemistry, Zoology, and Mathematics.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary for Central University of Punjab Contractual Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Contractual Faculty posts in Pharmacy, Law, and Economics carry a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 64,000/-. Part-Time Faculty posts are paid Rs. 1,000/- per lecture.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for Central University of Punjab Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official recruitment portal at https://cuprec.samarth.edu.in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of selection for CUPB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a walk-in interview. No separate call letters are issued; eligible candidates who applied online must directly attend the interview on the scheduled date, time, and venue.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for Central University of Punjab Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 100/-, applicable to candidates other than SC/ST/PWD/Women, who are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the Central University of Punjab walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Conference Room, VC Office, Aryabhata Academic Block, Central University of Punjab, Badal-Bathinda Road, Village Ghudda, District Bathinda, Punjab.

faq.question: Q7. What is the duration of the contractual faculty engagement?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely temporary and contractual, for one semester (up to dispersal of classes, i.e., 18.12.2026), or till the posts are filled on a regular basis, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required at the Central University of Punjab interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry the printed application form, original and self-attested educational/experience certificates, caste certificate (if applicable), last pay certificate, NOC (if required), passport-size photographs, and Aadhaar card, among other supporting documents.
